items.description: a Python-based disassembler inspired by the Hex-Rays Decompiler (XHydra) in IDA Pro. It disassembles x86/x64 binaries, generates C-like pseudocode, and detects advanced anti-disassembly techniques such as junk code, overlapping instructions, opaque predicates, self-modifying code,
